title: TOEFL iBT Full Mock Test 14
instructions: TOEFL iBT 2026 format: about 90 minutes total — Reading and Listening (18–27 min each on the real test, which is multi-stage adaptive), Speaking (~12 min) and Writing (~23 min). The real 2026 test adapts its second stage to your performance; this practice test is fixed-form at a representative difficulty. Scores are reported on the new 1–6 band scale alongside the legacy 0–120 scale through 2028.
